preferences.themeSystemHint: With System, the interface follows your operating system's light or dark setting.

assistant.title: AI assistant
assistant.emptyTitle: The AI assistant is coming soon
assistant.emptyDescription: It will know which page and objects you are working on and help you model and analyze.
assistant.capabilitiesLabel: Once available, you can ask it to:
assistant.capabilityExtract: Identify terms, object types and relations in documents and draft a change set
assistant.capabilityExplain: Explain the objects, properties and constraints on the current page
assistant.capabilityAsk: Query the ontology and business data in natural language
assistant.reviewNote: AI only makes suggestions. Every change takes effect only after you review it.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Continue with your platform account
login.validationSummary: Enter your username and password to sign in.
login.help: No account yet? Ask your platform administrator to create one.

workbench.title: Workbench
workbench.info: The workbench gathers the items that need your attention and recent platform activity.
workbench.aiCardDescription: Upload policies, procedures and manuals. AI identifies the terms, object types and relations in them and prepares a change set for your review.
workbench.uploadNeedsRole: Uploading documents requires the {{role}} role. Ask your platform administrator for access.
workbench.activityEmpty: Uploads, reviews and releases will appear here.

changeset.created: submitted a change set for review

not_configured.title: The AI service is not configured
not_configured.description: Documents can still be uploaded and saved, but AI will not analyze them. Ask your platform administrator to configure the model service.

unreachable.title: AI analysis is temporarily unavailable
unreachable.description: Documents can still be uploaded and saved. Retry failed documents once AI is back.

create.title: Name your ontology first
create.description: The ontology holds the object types, relations and properties AI finds in your documents. Your documents upload right after you name it.
create.name: Ontology name
create.validationSummary: Enter an ontology name to create it.

upload.hint: docx, xlsx, pdf, md or txt, up to {{size}} MB per file
upload.uploadedDescription: AI is analyzing them. See the results on the Documents page.

rejected.type: This file type is not supported. Upload a docx, xlsx, pdf, md or txt file.
rejected.size: The file is larger than {{size}} MB. Split or compress it and upload again.
rejected.empty: The file is empty. Check it and choose it again.

documents.noOntologyDescription: Once members upload documents, they and their AI results are listed here.
documents.noOntologyUploadTitle: Upload your first document: drag it here, or
documents.emptyTitle: This ontology has no documents yet
documents.emptyDescription: Once members upload documents, their progress and AI results are listed here.
documents.emptyUploadTitle: Upload your first document: drag it here, or
documents.failedUnknown: Processing did not finish. Try again.

changeset.invalid_item: The AI result was incomplete, so no change set was created. Try again.

internal.error: Something went wrong while processing the document. It is saved; try again.

evidence.notFound: This quote was not found in the source. Check the source before deciding.

review.noOntologyDescription: After documents are uploaded, the changes AI suggests are collected into change sets that wait here for review.
review.emptyTitle: This ontology has no change sets yet
review.emptyDescription: After documents are uploaded, the changes AI suggests are collected into change sets that wait here for review.
review.detailInfo: Accept, edit or reject each AI suggestion. Once everything is decided, merge the accepted items into the working ontology.
review.mergeFailedTitle: The change set was not merged
review.mergedDescription: Changes applied to the working ontology: {{count}}.
review.readOnlyNotice: You can view this change set. Accepting, rejecting and editing require the {{role}} role.
review.noItems: This change set has no items.

evidence_not_found.label: Quote not found
evidence_not_found.description: The quote AI cited was not found in the source, so its confidence was lowered. Check the source before deciding.

possible_duplicate.label: Possible duplicate
possible_duplicate.description: This may duplicate an element already in the ontology. Confirm before accepting.

edit.title: Edit {{name}}

description.entity_type: The merge uses your edited values. The local name forms the IRI and uses PascalCase, such as SteelSlab.
description.relation_type: The merge uses your edited values. The local name forms the IRI and uses camelCase, such as producedBy.
description.property: The merge uses your edited values. The local name forms the IRI and uses camelCase, such as slabThickness.

edit.validationSummary: Fields to fix: {{count}}. Correct them and save again.

errors.localNamePascal: Start with an uppercase letter and use only letters and digits, such as SteelSlab
errors.localNameCamel: Start with a lowercase letter and use only letters and digits, such as producedBy
errors.parentSelf: A type cannot be its own parent

ontologyPage.exportFailed: The Turtle file was not exported
ontologyPage.noOntologyDescription: After documents are uploaded and AI suggestions are reviewed, object types, relations and properties appear here.

graph.label: Ontology graph: {{nodes}} object types, {{edges}} connections
graph.a11yNode: Press Enter or Space to see the details of this object type.
graph.a11yEdge: This line is a relation or a parent-type link between object types.
graph.emptyDescription: Once change sets are reviewed and merged, object types and their relations are drawn here.

list.noMatchDescription: Try another keyword or remove a filter.
list.emptyTitle: The ontology has no elements yet
list.emptyDescription: Once change sets are reviewed and merged, object types, relations and properties are listed here.

detail.noProvenance: This element did not come from a reviewed change set.

releases.noOntologyDescription: Once an ontology exists and AI suggestions are reviewed, you can publish releases here.
releases.emptyDescription: Once a reviewer publishes a release, every immutable version is listed here.
releases.emptyDescriptionReviewer: Publishing saves the working ontology as an immutable version for export and external use.
releases.exportFailed: The Turtle file was not exported

publish.title: Publish new release
publish.description: Publishing saves the current working ontology as an immutable version. Names, references and parent types are checked first.
publish.openChangeSetsDescription: Unmerged change sets are not part of this release. Review and merge them first to include them.
publish.titlePlaceholder: For example: First steel production ontology
publish.validationSummary: Enter a release title to publish.
publish.invalidTitle: The release check did not pass ({{count}})
publish.invalidDescription: Fix these problems in review, then publish again:

problems.unknown: Did not pass the release check. Check this element.

release.invalid_parent: The parent type does not exist or is not a valid object type
release.invalid_domain: The owning object type (domain) does not exist or is deprecated
release.invalid_range: The target object type (range) does not exist or is deprecated
release.invalid_datatype: The data type is not one the platform supports
release.invalid_local_name: The local name does not follow the naming rules

activate.title: Make v{{version}} the current release?
activate.change: The current release changes from v{{from}} to v{{to}}.
activate.first: v{{to}} becomes the current release of this ontology.
activate.consequence: Queries, Q&A and exports offered to others will use the content of v{{to}}. The working ontology is not affected, and you can switch again later.
activate.done: v{{version}} is now the current release
activate.failedTitle: The current release was not changed

documents.info: Upload business documents and follow their parsing status and AI analysis results.

review.info: Review change sets item by item: accept, edit or reject each change. Only approved changes enter the ontology.

ontology.info: Browse object types, relations and properties as a graph or a list. Select an element to see its details and source evidence.

data.info: Connect data sources, browse table catalogs and bind data to the ontology.
data.emptyDescription: Here you will connect data sources read-only and bind tables and columns to object types and properties.

explore.info: Browse business objects by ontology, follow relations or ask questions in natural language.
explore.emptyDescription: Here you will browse business objects by ontology, trace them along relations and ask AI questions.

releases.info: Publish immutable releases, export Turtle, and make an earlier release current again when needed.

settings.info: Manage your account information and interface preferences.
settings.preferencesInfo: Preferences are saved in this browser only. Set them again on another browser or device.
settings.platformDescription: Settings for models, members and roles, and platform parameters are coming soon.

states.errorTitle: This content could not be loaded
states.forbiddenDescription: Viewing this content requires the {{role}} role. Ask your platform administrator for access.
states.notFoundDescription: The page you are looking for does not exist or has moved.
states.appErrorTitle: The platform is not available right now

errors.unknown: The action did not complete. Try again later, and contact your platform administrator if the problem continues.

network.unreachable: Cannot reach the platform service. Check your network connection and try again.

internal.error: Something went wrong on the platform. Try again later, and contact your platform administrator if the problem continues.

auth.invalid_credentials: The username or password is incorrect. Check them and try again.
auth.not_authenticated: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
auth.csrf_failed: This page has expired. Refresh the page and try again.
auth.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Try again later.
auth.forbidden: You do not have permission for this action. Contact your platform administrator.

validation.failed: Some fields are missing or invalid. Check them and try again.

ontology.not_found: The ontology does not exist or was deleted. Refresh the page and try again.
ontology.key_taken: An ontology with this identifier already exists. Choose another name and try again.

element.not_found: This element does not exist or was deleted.

changeset.not_found: The change set does not exist or was deleted.
changeset.closed: This change set has been merged or rejected and can no longer change. Refresh the page to see its current state.
changeset.pending_items: Some items are still undecided. Decide every item before merging.
changeset.invalid_edit: The edited values are not valid. Check the names, local name and referenced object types.
changeset.stale_target: the target element changed after the change set was created
changeset.dependency_skipped: an item it refers to was rejected or skipped
changeset.invalid_item: its content is incomplete or invalid

release.not_found: The release does not exist or was deleted.
release.invalid: The ontology did not pass the release check. Fix the problems and publish again.

documents.not_found: The document does not exist or was deleted.
documents.too_large: The file is larger than 20 MB. Split or compress it and upload again.
documents.unsupported_type: This file type is not supported. Upload a docx, xlsx, pdf, md or txt file.
documents.not_failed: This document did not fail, so it does not need a retry.
documents.needs_ocr: This document is a scan and its text cannot be extracted yet. Upload a version with selectable text.
documents.unreadable: No text could be read even after transcribing the scan. Check the file or upload a version with selectable text.

ai.not_configured: The AI service is not configured. The document is saved; ask your platform administrator to configure it, then retry.
ai.unavailable: AI analysis is temporarily unavailable. The document is saved; try again later.
ai.invalid_output: AI returned a result in an unexpected format. The document is saved; try again later.

http.400: The request is not valid. Check your input and try again.
http.401: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
http.403: You do not have permission for this action. Contact your platform administrator.
http.404: The requested content does not exist or was deleted.
http.409: The content was changed by another action. Refresh the page and try again.
http.413: The file is too large. Split or compress it and upload again.
http.415: This file type is not supported.
http.422: Some fields are missing or invalid. Check them and try again.
http.429: Too many requests. Try again later.
http.5xx: The platform service is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
